# Rolnopol UI

Read [the shared repository context](../../.agents/skills/CONTEXT.md), then use
[playwright-test-automation](../../.agents/skills/playwright-test-automation/SKILL.md)
for UI design and implementation. These files own the workflow, learning mode,
data rules and validation scope; do not duplicate them here.

For feedback on a small exercise, use
[code-review](../../.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md).
For shared fixtures, sessions or several dependent files, use
[code-review-advanced](../../.agents/skills/code-review-advanced/SKILL.md).

Explore browser behavior with an available tool when observation is needed.
MCP is optional. Select the browser tool according to the active environment;
do not require installation or a separate planning document before reading code.
